policies.title: Belgian ordinary passports: South Sudan electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Belgian Foreign Affairs confirms that Belgian visitors may apply online, and South Sudan's government service issues an approved eVisa PDF before travel.
conditions: Applies to a current ordinary Belgian passport for short visitor travel.
Submit the online application before departure and download the approved eVisa PDF for presentation at entry.
The separate embassy channel, registration after arrival, work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside this classification.
Belgian Foreign Affairs advises against travel; this classification does not imply safety or guaranteed admission.

application.label: South Sudan government eVisa
steps: Create an account and submit the visitor application and fee online before travel.
Download the approved eVisa PDF and present it with the same passport at entry.
